title: Summon
subtitle: Design a clear signal, a reachable response, and a useful opening.
summary: The boss calls a limited group of helpers, changing priorities without flooding the arena.
overview: A summon temporarily adds new actors and decisions to the fight. It works when arrival points, roles, and limits are clear, and when handling the helpers creates a real tradeoff with attacking the boss.
learning: Tune the signal, the arrival points and active limit, response time, and recovery.

demo.title: Test the pattern
phaseDescriptions: The boss signals where and how many helpers will appear.
A limited group enters through visible arrival points.
The helpers take distinct roles while the boss remains committed.
demo.reducedMotion: Autoplay is disabled by the reduced-motion setting. Use the timeline slider to inspect the loop.
demo.diagramDescription: A looping diagram of summon. The boss signals the pattern, the player responds, and both return smoothly to their starting positions.

steps.title: Is the signal specific?
steps.body: Reveal arrival points, count, and helper type before they become dangerous.

steps.title: Is the response reachable?
steps.body: Set a strict active limit and test whether every target remains readable.

steps.title: Is the opening useful?
steps.body: Decide whether the call exposes the boss or rewards clearing helpers first.

mistakes.title: Hidden rule
mistakes.body: If the signal does not reveal the arrival points and active limit, the hit feels arbitrary.

mistakes.title: Wrong scale
mistakes.body: If timing is tested only at one upgrade level, the pattern can become trivial or unavoidable.

designNotes.title: Match visuals and collision
designNotes.body: The visible threat must match the active hitbox in space and time.

designNotes.title: Start with ordinary abilities
designNotes.body: Keep one response available with abilities the player already has.

designNotes.title: Retest upgrades
designNotes.body: Check movement, range, damage, and invulnerability against every phase.

story.title: Make the arena support the rule
story.body: Give each arrival point room and keep helpers from spawning on the player.

adaptation.title: Respect player upgrades
adaptation.body: Test the strongest available build. If an attack is blocked, make the immunity clear and preserve another useful response.

distinction.title: Name the exact pattern
distinction.body: A summon adds actors with their own behavior. A projectile or hazard has no independent role.

lensNotes.body: The boss gives up another action while the pattern develops.
A readable response turns pressure into a decision.
More coverage or duration earns a clearer opening.
The pattern tests skills taught before this encounter.

examples.body: The boss releases enemies from visible containers, making wave size and cleanup central to the encounter.

examples.boss: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
examples.body: Temporary spirit summons vary the threat without remaining forever, while the casting window exposes the boss.
Each new phase relocates the boss and restores a surrounding group of spiderlings. Rebuilding the escort turns the phase transition into renewed spatial pressure.
